Name: Stacy
Dialog: Perry? What is all this? (Perry hands Stacy a pamphlet) A-a host family, mind erasing, balloon coverup? I mean is all this really necessary? (Perry shrugs) Wait a minute! It says right here in your silly little pamphlet that if your host family finds out about your agent status, then anyone who's seen you has to have their memory erased, or you'll get relocated. Perry, I'm not part of your host family!  I know, I know, it's a technicality. Look, I don't want Candace and the boys to lose you, but I also do not want my mind erased. I'm on the last ten minutes of that Grievance movie, and I don't want to have to watch that whole scary mess again. So, uh, can we just keep this a secret? (Perry smiles and tips his hat to Stacy)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, I am so proud of myself! I think I totally hooked this thing up! It's incredible! It has picture-in-picture-in-picture! I'll be able to watch a show and then another show inside that show and then the first show again inside that one! And I managed to get it down to one clicker! I'm about to give it a whirl! (She points and clicks, but it turns off and on the TV of a neighbor's house behind her.) Hmm. (The neighbor behind her gets up and sees his TV turn on and off again in frustration.) Okay. Maybe there's still a bug or two to fix.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (To the movie) Don't go in there. Don't go in there. Don't go in there. Don't go in there. You went in there. Oh, gross she brought thousands of tiny bugs into the house. What could be worse than that? (Doofenshmirtz's bus crashes into Stacy's house) Big bug! Ahhh! (Stacy hides behind the couch) OMG! Perry! What are you doing here?! And why are you wearing a hat? Look out! (Doofenshmirtz flies onto the couch) And who's this pharmacist?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh, mysterious force. I feel a little awkward talking to you, because I didn't believe in you at first. Because lets face it, it's crazy, but then I saw you eat my friend, so, I've made a little shrine here. It's...It's nice, there's a banana, and, uh, oh, Mr. Miggins! So, I hope this makes up for the disbelief thing. Are we, uh, are we good?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hmm, that's tough. One on hand, if you go with the achromatic pink, it kinda says "Hi, I'm Candace, and I'm bedraggled and pallid". Trust me, you don't want that. I've been both. But, if you go with the more saturated pink, it kinda gives you that "overkill, out-to-kill, my currency is urgency" look.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I brought you a get-well package. Miso soup-- heats itself, don't ask-- Who Wants To Be A Total Idiot 3, and rocky road ice cream! You don't want everything to be good. And you don't have to worry about your brothers - your mom says they're off playing miniature golf. (Scoffs) How lame is that?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Too much. (Candace wears a bikini; now offscreen.) Too little. (Candace wears a pinafore.) Ugh, too clean. (Candace wears torn cords and a hippie t-shirt.) Too dirty. (Candace wears a street clothing.) Too street. (Candace wears a goth suit.) Too goth. (Cut to her.) Where'd you get that?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Picks up the phone) Well, do you blame me? (Imitating Candace) Oh, Jeremy and I went to the movies, Jeremy's house smells like gingerbread, ever notice Jeremy's mole is shaped like an adorable puppy? I'm starting to feel like the only reason you hang out with me is to talk about Jeremy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, you got the look and you got the attitude. Now there's just one last test to see if you're a true emo. Do you have enough ennui to resist the urge to bust your brothers? (Candace looks out the window, seeing her brothers building the pool) I don't think your Mom would approve.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Fixing her hair) Whoa. What was that all about? Do the Flynn Fletchers know you fight evil scientists? (Stacy accidentally steps on the remote firing the -inator, and Perry whacks it with a bat, destroying it. The -inator beam bounces off a satellite and heads back towards Earth)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Wow, thanks, Candace! Most of this is a genuine label, but the shoes are a total knockoffs. I heard there's a riot Uptown at this one store that got a fresh shipment. I gotta run before they sell out. Bye! Oh, and Candace? Friendly tip; That Gaston stuff is so 42 seconds ago.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So my mom told me to clean up my room and I didn't have any shoes on, so I started picking stuff up with my feet, and I turned it into a game with myself, like, "Can I Clean Up My Whole Room With My Feet?" And I did. (her cell phone rings) Oh, it's Coltrane. Hello?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (scoffs) Figures. The power goes out right in the middle of the movie. Good thing I got the power generator package option. Okay, let's see. (reading manual) "For your safety, please make sure to wear included protective gear when operating the generator."

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (coming in with the magazine) Hey, Candace, (flipping the pages) I just realized you added up your score wrong! Your true teen identity is actually the... (Shows quiz in magazine) "Busting and Crush Obsessed Older Sister Type Who Can't Do Math".

Name: Stacy
Dialog: "Boys are human beings too. (Camera rotates, showing Stacy holding the magazine) If you're interested in one of them, make them feel comfortable by asking him questions about himself." Okay, they lost me at the "boys/human beings" thing.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, looks to me like you're going about this the wrong way. Don't focus on the boys; focus on the invention. If you can find out where the stuff goes, maybe you can take your Mom there and she'd finally see the evidence.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I'm trying to hook up this super-high-def-intelligent-multi-format-entertainment-DVR system. I wanna keep the DVD and the VCR but I don't think there are enough holes. I mean, there's also a pretty serious clicker situation.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Look, the way I see it, you prevented me from going to the spa, almost killed me with a jackhammer, dropped a wall on me, I've gypsum in my hair, and basically wasted my whole day. But you did it for love, so it's okay.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, are you sure you can handle this? (They go out to the backyard.) It took me four days to pry you out from under the bed last time we saw a scary movie. (outside) What? What are you looking at? Oh no.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: 'Cause someone just IM'd me that someone else heard someone else overhear that Jeremy is gonna call you and ask you out for a special evening tonight! (Both squeal) Candace, do you need medical attention?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Great! Here we go! (A Doof zombie attempts to stalk behind her, but she pulls the chord and unintentionally punches the zombie unconscious.) Nice! Hooked up a video system and a generator! I am good!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What? Sweet! It's working. Candace, when you hear the trigger word, um, (cut to poster that says "Holy Guacamole") "holy guacamole", you will no longer have the desire to bust Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: And so begins The Grievance movie marathon. Special edition box set. Oh, yeah. "Hey, Stacy, didja hook up that whole system by yourself?" "Yeah, no biggie. Do it all the time." Heh heh. I rule.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You can't let fear rule your life, Candace. Jeremy likes you. He's not gonna say no. Now, I'm gonna hang up, and when I do, I want you to call Jeremy. Don't man the phone, girl. Phone the man!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It's so nice to sit and be responsible for a change. Just...focused, you know? And Candace and I were thinking that, oh, a live musical event might be a good opportunity for us to really...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Flipping through a Cockney for tourists book) I'm working on it. Ah! He said "They were here, they carted away some junk from out back, and, aren't they a little young to be doing that?"

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Relax Candace, it's simple math. Instead of 350 for one hour, we'll just cook this for five minutes at... (punches buttons on a calculator) ...9000 degrees. (Pause) What could go wrong?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, let's see what you gotta do. "Invent a new ice cream flavor, win a first-grade spelling bee, ride a unicorn, and conquer fear of spiders." Ha! Good luck with that last one.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, I am tired of taking the backseat to the totally unlikely chance that you will bust your brothers. I want a best friend I can count on. So, you're gonna have to choose

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, look! (Flips the magazine) It says here that Flawless Girl founder, Blanca Dishon, will be at the Mid-Summer's Festival in search of the next Flawless Girl spokes-model.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, good. You know how my mom wants me to take things more seriously and focus on more important things like grades, my future, or becoming a doctor, a lawyer, or a doctor?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay. Focus, focus, focus. You can do this, Stacy. Don't get seduced by the coolness. Wuh-oh. "Elevator to the coolness"? (Steps on to the elevator) This is so cool!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What's this? Dancing weasels? (Candace rotates the notepad) Oh, "busted." Oh, you want me to bust your brothers. You know, you really gotta work on your penmanship.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I'm coming as fast as I can, Candace! I'm at your house. Now, what kind of emergency are we dealing with? A parent emergency? A Phineas and Ferb emergency? Oh my--

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Listen up, twerps. Just because Candace is sick doesn't mean you can get away with anything. I am now her eyes, ears and mouth. Basically I'm her whole face.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (after looking at Candace's text message) Wow! I'm surprised the spelling checker didn't catch that. (at Phineas) I've got to deliver a message to your mom.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: No, no, no, no, Candace! This is a bad idea! About as bad as you've ever had in a loong line, and I love you when you say this, really, really bad ideas.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: There's nothing to be afraid of. Spiders are harmless. (opens a cage) Look. I'm sticking my hand in the cage. Hello there, little guy. (gets bitten) Huh!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (to the TV) Look out! She's right behind you! (the power shuts off) Ugh! You gotta be kiddin' me! Talk about Grievance interruptus. (gets off the couch)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You know, 1843 when James Braid published the "Rationale of Somnambulism" in which he invented the term "hypnotism", named after the Greek god, Hypnos.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I miss you, Candace! I miss when we would spend time together, just the two of us. And I bet you didn't remember that today is the Danville Steet Fair.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It's miniature golf! And it's so unbelievably cool! With a windmill and a dinosaur, and – (Candace silences Stacy by covering her mouth with her hand)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace! Did you hear? I won! I actually won in miniature golf! It just goes to show you that if you focus, you can accomplish anything. (Sneezes)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, I'd love to hear more, and I'm sure I will, but right now I'm trying to finish this documentary on Easter Island. Man, I wish I could go.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, come on, Candace. You're overthinking this. (The cashier puts a watermelon on the tread.) Jeremy'll love anything you make. What's your worry?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Slow down. Remember how you thought Jeremy was with a girl and she wasn't even a she? And then you ended up on that snowboard all out of control?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, so the top three items on the Heather Magazine 11-step guide to be the true emo teen are dark hair, dark clothes, and pencil-thin jeans.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on laptop) I think we were headed into the forest with the Grizzly King. Are you sure you don't wanna wait until you finished your chores?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (to Candace over the phone, reading from a rulebook) While the linesmen may call only obvious technical infractions. (to Ginger) Go away!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (To the waiter) Two ice teas please. So, Candace, sorry I was so hard on you before. I know you and Jeremy aren't together all the time.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (in her room, talking to Candace on phone) So, how did you d- (Candace screams at the phone) Okay, wh- (Candace screams again) You done?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Sooo...since you're in busting mode, I take it, my services are not required? (Candace does not answer) Yep, I'm superfluous. (leaves)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (looks out the window and sees the boys in the backyard) Umm, I'm probably gonna regret this, but wouldn't a giant robot insect count?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So maybe a pocket knife, or a fishing lure,...or a compound bow. (imitates someone shooting an arrow) Take that, apple on kid's head!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, "holy guacamole" - no busting, "leaping lizards" - back to normal. (Snaps fingers and Candace comes out of hypnotic trance.)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You know, as teenage sub-cultures go, it's not so bad. You just need a new look to match your true teen identity. I'll be right over.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: ...and I know this neighbor who knows this hair-washer, who knows this bank teller, who knows this back-waxer who works at the spa.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace! We're about to go on! (cut back to Candace) Where are you?! Candace? (Candace smiles nervously.) Candace?! Are you there?!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, what happened to you? The lecture's over. The gift bags were totally cruddy, by the way. It's just a bag, nothing in it.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: And as for diving, you been perfecting that quintuple-somersault backflip-jacknife-swandive for a week now. You're Candace Flynn!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Alright, look. You're getting oil all over the place. Someone's going to have to-- (Stacy trips, and falls in the pool of oil.)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Look! The controls are just like the video game! Let's show 'em our mad skills. Woo-hoo! Let's dance, dweebs! (They wrestle)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (emerging from the head with a handful of plungers) I found more harpoons! And I'm gonna pretend these have never been used!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on phone) Uh, hello? The ultimate bust just falls in your lap and you're not gonna jump at the chance? What's up with that?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, I hope it does do "it", because Jeremy's getting huger by the minute. I know because Megan's blog says she thinks so.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on headphones talking to Candace) I've got the hockey reference manuals, league website, and official rules up and ready!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So yeah, I get it. It's a huge honor and everything. But come on Candace, why do you really want to be Rutabaga Princess?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (standing next to Coltrane) That was easy. (they look down and see that they're holding hands, then smile at each other)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Glares) No, I don't understand! We've been planning this for like three weeks! It's like four months in teenager years!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You see? Candace level-headed and responsible. She's not a bit worried about what Phineas and Ferb are doing right now.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (from inside) Futons, bouillon, platypus food... (Cut to her, looking in a pantry.) Ooh! Microwave popcorn! Need this.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: This doesn't seem right Candace. I mean, four eggs bleated, a big bow, one pound of lamp—I mean that's not even food.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, I guess if you're going to have an unhealthy mind frame, it might as well benefit me. Now, the mall is waiting.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh! I know, Hair bows. They're all the rage this days. Just don't wear any feather-earrings, they're so last Tuesday.

Name: Candace/Stacy
Dialog: Yeah!  (The yellow robot's mouth opens to reveal water with a lifeboat, an oar and a couple of fish to come out) Ew!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace? Hey, Candace! Awesome scooter! Hey, wanna come to Slushy Burger with my mom and me? Was that a yes or a no?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Wait... (looks at watch) Now! We're exactly fashionably late! (people talking) We're here! This is gonna be so cool!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I just got my little bunny-bear! It's a cross between a bunny and a bear! You get it? It's the most precious thing.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (peeks out from dressing room) By the way, the best part was when you used him as a table. (closes curtain) BUSTED!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ooh, a whole day without Jeremy and you're not obsessing about it? Who are you and what have you done with Candace?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Now, when I snap my fingers, you will awaken with no recollection of being hypnotized. Do you understand, Candace?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: No, no. She likes you just fine, she just thinks...you're, I don't know, flighty and unfocused from time to time.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Jeremy thinks you'll go with him anywhere, anytime, just for the asking. Don't be a lapdog, Candace. Just say no!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, I know. I heard it from Christina, who heard it from Jenny, who heard it from Jessie who heard it from you!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: And when you hear (cut to poster that says "Leapin' Lizards") "leaping lizards", it'll make you return to normal.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Wait. Following all over yourself to bust your brothers is exactly what makes you look so flighty and unfocused.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, she's forcing me to go to this leadership seminar today, and I'll implode with boredom if I go by myself.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, here, let me get your train. (Holds onto Candace's cape, then hears a loud squeak) Oh, omigosh, sorry!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Love Händel? That's my mother's favorite band! (phone beeps) Hey, Mom, did you know Love Händel is reforming?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hmm, the last step, I forget. Hey, Chad, do you remember what the last step to achieving your goal thingy is?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, you can stop that right now. You're starting to sound like one of those TV show we like to make fun of.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on phone) AAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!! My ticket is in row R!!!! Close enough to smell them!!!!! What did you get?!!?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, why are you acting so nervous? I'm not mad anymore. I'm going to go pay for our drinks. (She leaves)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, too bad Jeremy didn't order a pizza. Then, you can hang out with him and find out what guys talk about.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on videophone & Angrily) Candace?! What the heck are you doin'?! You're supposed to be playing hard to ge—

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh, excuse me for a second. (Candace repeats her "bird call") I have to go talk to my friend in the bushes.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Notices Meap, and mistakes it for Candace's Bango-ru) Oh, Candace! Look at it! It's so cute, I could die!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You mean like hieroglyphics? Those were deciphered in the early 1800s after they found the Rosetta Stone.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Quickly and nervously) How should I know!? Why are you asking me!? How should I know!? Don't look at me!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What are you talking about? They've been nothing but... Look out! ...nice to us since we got on the bus.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Mom said if I'm going to a grown-up concert, she wants me to go with someone more...grounded and mature.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I don't know, Candace, you're just lucky that bat didn't bite you. I mean, what if it was a vampire bat?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: "Mysterious Force"?, I'm not buying it, I am a woman of science, at least that's what my horoscope said.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (sighs) Then why are we sitting here? (she grabs Candace's hand) Come on Chuckles, let's have some fun.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, to the Internet. (starts typing on her laptop) Here we go. Emos believe everyone's against them.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, this article specifically says not to growl psychotically. It makes boys feel uncomfortable.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Snake wrestler? Whatever. You've fought dinosaurs! You've been to Mars! You've traveled through time!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, but you'd never be able to see yourself in the mirror again. How would you put on your make-up?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh, I was gonna, but the elevator and the slide, and... (Candace slaps her hand over Stacy's mouth)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: The irony is, that as a grown up, you don't NEED to tell your mom. You can just bust them yourself.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I think you look like you just fell off a turnip truck, and then got run over by a rutabaga truck.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (she and Jenny walk in) I took the liberty of bringing some DVDs for our party viewing pleasure.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You see? That's what I'm talking about; self-righteous flowers? What are self-righteous flowers?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, Candace, look, is that a submarine? (Helicopter whirring) And aren't those your brothers?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, if you want him to call you his girlfriend, maybe you should call him your boyfriend.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You know, you finally have everything you ever wanted. Call me when you get over it. (leaves)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You know, you finally have everything you ever wanted. Call me when you get over it. (leaves)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Let's not jump to conclusions yet. (both crawl under everyone and pop up from behind a chair)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, look at it, all swollen and useless. You are one sorry, laid-up, mummy-footed bed potato.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It will be even scarier 'cause my family's out for the day and we will be alone at the house.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You wouldn't have started this club because gelatin is Jeremy's favorite dessert, would you?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Sorry, I don't think there's anything I can do, but there are a couple of guys who could...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: No! Don't walk into the kitchen, Grievance lady! Ohhh! Gosh! How could she be so oblivious?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, they tricked it out for you, cool. Come on, lets go to the convention. (She rides off)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Just kidding, Candace. Candace! Oh boy, I gotta work on my delivery. It's way too deadpan.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, I give up! It's a good thing you won that contest to perform backup with Love Händel.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on laptop) I'll turn them into s'mores with my super sugar squeal! Bye bye, Wonder Kid!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You're right. I can do this if I stay focused. Focus, focus, focus! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, you got to believe in yourself. What do French girls have that you don't have?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, say hi to Jeremy for me! And hey, you should stop by and see my cousins in Tokyo!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, got it. Although, it looks like they've got their hands full with Khaka Peu Peu.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. When I heard you were sick, I came right over. Today I am your servant.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Via recording) You've reached Stacy's mobile. Leave a message, I'll get back to you.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Sorry, sorry. Got a little distracted there. You know, London, cool stores, shopping.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Let's just go over and say hi. (leads Candace over to the two boys, who are talking)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, mysterious force. You can see I'm really trying here. Please bring back Candace!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (looking out of the window) Huh! What's that your brothers are building down there?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh no, I think it's really paying off here. (Candace continues saying "Get off me")

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, I have absolutely no idea what I'm doing. What are all these buttons for?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You guys have got to work on your pet names for each other. So what's in the safe?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (also dressed as the Scarlet Pimpernel) Hey, what's going—Oh, for crying out loud.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Are you sure Phineas and Ferb are really The Beak? He's just so heroic and hunky.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Doesn't matter. I doubt we'll not be able to eat while we're watching this movie.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That's it! Our appointment's in five minutes, and I'm going with or without you.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, I don't know... Lately I've been feeling like a third wheel around you guys.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Do you have this jumpsuit in pink? Cause I'm not really a tangerine kind of gal.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It's so... I mean, I've come to deliver a message with an unimpressed demeanor.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It's written on your poster. Apparently he also invented the comb-over. Freaky.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yep, we're all grown up now. No more pigtails, dollies, or obsessing over boys.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (After seeing a bunch of cats chasing a laser) Okay, that's like a lot of cats.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Didn't you get my text message? "Call You Later, Best Friends Forever. Stacy."

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Girl, I have already cashed that check, and I don't even know what that means.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hi, it's Stace. Do you think you could bring a sandwich platter to the party?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: But what about the... (Candace elbows her again; she falls to the ground) Ow!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: If you mean the pocket watch, then yes. Why do you want to do this, Candace?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Care to explain why "Despair" isn't picking up her cell phone this morning?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, we can't because we're going to the... (Candace quickly elbows her) Ow!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (seeing Big Ben about to launch, taps on Candace's shoulder) Uh...Candace?!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey! I found all kinds of cute things! Move over, I'm going to try them on.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You're losing right now and losers don't have star quality! Say something!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, Candace, this is all the money you gave me, so this is my final bid.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh no you don't! This is gonna be a new year with a new Candace! Remember?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, but don't forget - we are on the bus helping the band write a song.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (On cell phone) Candace, I heard you're Goth now. Why didn't you tell me?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (To Candace) Coltrane and Jeremy's gig got cancelled. Can they come over?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Let your subconscious do the deciding. Go with the one you touched first.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Really? Great! But no—Jeremy -- anything. Okay? If I even hear his name--

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, I'm looking for some really cool... Wow, this table's really lumpy.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yes. I walked home from the mall to find... this. What is happening here?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, what are you doing? I've been trying to call you all afternoon!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Wow, that's so grown up! But you gotta be strong. Remember, hard to get.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, oh! And the part when the guy rollerskated into the toilet! (Laughs)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Check it out! They do make a card for a spilled cheese dog with mustard.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: C'mon! C'mon! (Ducky Momo retrieves the coin) Nice! You did it, Candace!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah. Candace wants you to go out front to see what the boys are doing.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Maybe you should just let whatever happens happen. You know, naturally.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry? What, I'm like the only person who's never said it.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh no! You had better not be ditching me to hang out with Jeremy again!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (as Candace keeps chattering) It's okay. It's just a temporary relapse.

Name: Young Stacy
Dialog: (offscreen) Candace, don't forget number four, conquer fear of spiders.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: There's just one more thing on the list. Get over your fear of spiders.

Name: Stacy
